name: empty
title: Empty
description: Placeholder cell with a title, a sentence, and an optional action.
docs: Raster leaves are StyleX. Compile them with @stylexjs/babel-plugin (Vite: @stylexjs/unplugin, Next: @stylexjs/nextjs-plugin). If you would rather not run a compiler, import @noorddev/raster-react instead: it ships precompiled with one stylesheet.

raster.snippet:
No projects yet

Start one. The grid is empty on purpose.
raster.example:
import { Button, Empty } from "@noorddev/raster-react";

<Empty title="No projects yet" action={<Button variant="ghost" size="sm">New project</Button>}>
  Start one. The grid is empty on purpose.
</Empty>

use: A list, table, or search with nothing to show.
One sentence and one action at most.

a11y: Plain text in a cell; the action is whatever you pass, so give it a real control.
